family: R15-B-dow breakthrough: UTC day-of-week filter on frozen v15 majority base (cheap, untried)
hypothesis: Crypto trades 24/7 so weekend behavior may differ from weekdays. DOW (function of signal_time UTC only, known at decision time, causal) may separate return regimes without refit. Untried per ledger round15 B-dow. Round14 lesson honored: pre-checked counts BEFORE running (majority n=94: mon-fri 64, sat-sun 30) so weekend branch is NOT pre-starved at signal level; per mission all branches run and report even if fills < 30, no branch dropped.
base_provenance: frozen v15 map-ensemble majority output: 2-of-3 vote with iso4 in majority, geometry is iso4 choose() output on agreement rows (see configs/opencode_v15_mapensemble.json). Never refit. Pre-loop verified: n=94 signals, columns include signal_time + direction; DOW derived from signal_time UTC only.

dow_distribution_precheck.note: pandas signal_time.utc dayofweek Mon=0..Sun=6; mon_fri = dow<=4, sat_sun = dow>=5

scope_key: Post-filter on frozen majority signals only (causal/past-only): all keeps everything; mon_fri keeps signal_time UTC dayofweek in {0,1,2,3,4} (Mon-Fri); sat_sun keeps dayofweek in {5,6} (Sat-Sun). DOW is a pure function of signal_time, known at candle-t close; no refit, no future data.
control: Reproduction gate or STOP: majority_all_1x normal must match B4 majority_1x (+165.18% total_return 1.6517829563633004, -20.09% max_drawdown -0.20086073993367803, 63 trades). Tolerance 1e-6 on return/drawdown, exact on trades.
